prayerExcerpt.en-US: Appear not to men to fast, but to thy Father Who is in heaven, and thy Father, Who seeth in secret, He will repay thee.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Não pareças aos homens que jejuas, mas a teu Pai que está no céu, e teu Pai, que vê em segredo, te recompensará.

meta.face: An Umbrian of about seventy with a soft, pale-pink complexion and a MOON-ROUND face — a low, rounded forehead, FULL, SOFT cheeks, a SMALL, SNUB nose, SMALL, ROUND light-brown eyes with REDDENED rims, moist with tears, under thin white brows lifted and DRAWN TOGETHER in the middle in compunction, a small, soft, trembling mouth, a soft double chin; white hair cut close round a monastic tonsure and a SHORT, SOFT, rounded white beard; the gaze lifted, simple and tearful. Not the long-bearded benedict, nor the square-faced Bonfilius or snub-nosed, dark-bearded Bonajuncta of servite_founders.
meta.basis: No likeness survives. Gregory the Great, who knew him, calls him an old man of 'simplicity and compunction' whose tears raised a dead man (Dialogues III.33), and the Martyrology keeps those words; the book's engraving shows him in a monk's habit. The face paints that simplicity and those tears; its structure is ours.
